description: CSR sparse matrix-vector multiply y = A*x. Each thread handles one row. Measures throughput in GB/s and GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: num_rows
scaling_param.description: Number of matrix rows (and columns) in the synthetic sparse matrix

non_scaling_params.name: nnz_per_row
non_scaling_params.description: Number of non-zero elements per row

non_scaling_params.name: iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations for averaging
